data.body: Deterministic reproduction recorded before the change (origin/main 57d45053272, 2026-11-17 PST). A scratch conftest wraps `rebar.reducer._cache.atomic_write` so that a rewrite of an existing path keeps that path's first mtime (`os.utime`), which models a coarse-timestamp filesystem. With it, `test_cache_invalidated_on_file_deletion` fails every time with `assert 1794938767.5136957 != 1794938767.5136957`. The same run's write log shows 2 cache writes, `(dir_hash 758d9db617d7, 1 comment)` then `(65d2f56cb3ad, 0 comments)`. So the reducer did recompute and rewrite the cache, and only the mtime oracle failed.
